brief.topic: Reveal sealed capability evidence for three product modules of a single-user agent collaboration network: M5 execution & workspace isolation (git worktree per task, isolated agent workspace), M6 observability & replay (audit/run logs, events, scorecard, task node inspection), M12 technical design & deployment (architecture substrate, SQLite/persistence layout, local/container deployment). Problem-discovery stage; no adoption ranking.

criteria.question: M5: does the project isolate each task/agent in its own git worktree or cloned workspace, keeping parallel work from interfering?
keywords: each in its own worktree
Quickly split tasks into isolated environments
the platform clones the agent folder
APFS clone copy on macOS
task worktrees: `../herdr-worktrees/<task-slug>`
Do all code edits, tests, and validation inside the task worktree
Don't assume every workspace is a git worktree
starts worker agents in their own workspaces

criteria.question: M6: does the project expose observability or replay — audit/run logs, persisted events, task-node inspection, health/status signals?
keywords: run and audit logs live in a second file
automatic replay of in-flight work
Every observation event in the catalog
Follow task nodes, conditional branches, bounded review loops
State is separated from runtime
Shared runtime/session fact: belongs in server state
exposed through the JSON API/event path

criteria.question: M12: does the project document its technical architecture substrate and deployment model (persistence layout, local/container/cloud deployment, platform abstraction)?
keywords: SQLite** in the data directory stores platform state
The local filesystem holds agent workspaces
no parallel joins, multi-replica deployment, or elastic scaling
